title: Dr. Mason Miller
overview: Dr. Mason Miller is a world-renowned expert in memory erasure, a man who helps others forget what they can't live with. But when he begins experiencing surreal disruptions inside the sterile environment of a luxury resort, it becomes clear that nothing is as it seems. As he reconnects with a long-lost lover, relives ethically questionable cases, and unearths a buried trauma, Mason realizes he's not treating a patient, he is the patient.
